SELECT MAX(SUBSTRING(etl_batch_no, 1, 8)) FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE etl_batch_no REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}_' AND period = 'day' AND DATE(trade_time) = #{tradeDate}
SELECT MAX(SUBSTRING(etl_batch_no, 1, 8)) FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE etl_batch_no REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}_' AND period = 'day' AND DATE(trade_time) < #{tradeDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO etf_five_dimension_resonance ( etf_code, etf_name, trade_date, trade_time, signal_trend_long, signal_momentum_long, signal_warning, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, amount, dif, dea, macd, is_macd_golden_state, is_macd_red, macd_hist_direction, sar_value, is_sar_bullish, sar_trend, ma5, ma10, ma20, ma30, ma60, is_ma5_above_ma10, is_ma10_above_ma20, is_close_above_ma20, is_close_above_ma60, rsi6, rsi12, rsi24, k_value, d_value, j_value, boll_mid, boll_upper, boll_lower, atr14, adx14, is_yesterday_triggered, is_today_triggered, first_triggered_date_of_year, previous_triggered_date, last_triggered_date, source, etl_batch_no ) WITH latest_day_ta AS ( SELECT t.* FROM etf_ta_indicator t INNER JOIN ( SELECT etf_code, MAX(trade_time) AS max_trade_time FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE period = 'day' AND DATE(trade_time) = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY etf_code ) latest ON latest.etf_code = t.etf_code AND latest.max_trade_time = t.trade_time WHERE t.period = 'day' ), qualified_today AS ( SELECT etf_code FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE etl_batch_no LIKE CONCAT(#{latestBatchDate}, '_%') AND is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND is_sar_bullish = 1 GROUP BY etf_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 4 ), qualified_yesterday AS ( SELECT etf_code FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE etl_batch_no LIKE CONCAT(#{previousBatchDate}, '_%') AND is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND is_sar_bullish = 1 GROUP BY etf_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 4 ), qualified_history AS ( SELECT SUBSTRING(etl_batch_no, 1, 8) AS batch_day, etf_code FROM etf_ta_indicator WHERE etl_batch_no REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}_' AND is_macd_golden_state = 1 AND is_sar_bullish = 1 GROUP BY SUBSTRING(etl_batch_no, 1, 8), etf_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 4 ) SELECT sm.etf_code, sm.symbol AS etf_name, #{tradeDate} AS trade_date, t1.trade_time, COALESCE(t1.signal_trend_long, 0) AS signal_trend_long, COALESCE(t1.signal_momentum_long, 0) AS signal_momentum_long, COALESCE(t1.signal_warning, 0) AS signal_warning, t1.open_price, t1.high_price, t1.low_price, t1.close_price, t1.volume, t1.amount, t1.dif, t1.dea, t1.macd, COALESCE(t1.is_macd_golden_state, 0) AS is_macd_golden_state, COALESCE(t1.is_macd_red, 0) AS is_macd_red, COALESCE(t1.macd_hist_direction, 0) AS macd_hist_direction, t1.sar_value, COALESCE(t1.is_sar_bullish, 0) AS is_sar_bullish, COALESCE(t1.sar_trend, 0) AS sar_trend, t1.ma5, t1.ma10, t1.ma20, t1.ma30, t1.ma60, COALESCE(t1.is_ma5_above_ma10, 0) AS is_ma5_above_ma10, COALESCE(t1.is_ma10_above_ma20, 0) AS is_ma10_above_ma20, COALESCE(t1.is_close_above_ma20, 0) AS is_close_above_ma20, COALESCE(t1.is_close_above_ma60, 0) AS is_close_above_ma60, t1.rsi6, t1.rsi12, t1.rsi24, t1.k_value, t1.d_value, t1.j_value, t1.boll_mid, t1.boll_upper, t1.boll_lower, t1.atr14, t1.adx14, CASE WHEN qy.etf_code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_yesterday_triggered, CASE WHEN qt.etf_code IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_today_triggered, ( SELECT MIN(STR_TO_DATE(qh.batch_day, '%Y%m%d')) FROM qualified_history qh WHERE qh.etf_code = sm.etf_code AND SUBSTRING(qh.batch_day, 1, 4) = SUBSTRING(#{latestBatchDate}, 1, 4) AND qh.batch_day <= #{latestBatchDate} ) AS first_triggered_date_of_year, ( SELECT MAX(STR_TO_DATE(qh.batch_day, '%Y%m%d')) FROM qualified_history qh WHERE qh.etf_code = sm.etf_code AND qh.batch_day < #{latestBatchDate} ) AS previous_triggered_date, ( SELECT MAX(STR_TO_DATE(qh.batch_day, '%Y%m%d')) FROM qualified_history qh WHERE qh.etf_code = sm.etf_code AND qh.batch_day <= #{latestBatchDate} ) AS last_triggered_date, COALESCE(t1.source, 'AmazingData') AS source, COALESCE(t1.etl_batch_no, CONCAT(#{latestBatchDate}, '_FIVE_DIM')) AS etl_batch_no FROM etf_security_master sm LEFT JOIN latest_day_ta t1 ON t1.etf_code = sm.etf_code LEFT JOIN qualified_today qt ON qt.etf_code = sm.etf_code LEFT JOIN qualified_yesterday qy ON qy.etf_code = sm.etf_code WHERE COALESCE(sm.is_active, 1) = 1 ORDER BY t1.close_price DESC, sm.etf_code ASC ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE etf_name = VALUES(etf_name), trade_time = VALUES(trade_time), signal_trend_long = VALUES(signal_trend_long), signal_momentum_long = VALUES(signal_momentum_long), signal_warning = VALUES(signal_warning), open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount), dif = VALUES(dif), dea = VALUES(dea), macd = VALUES(macd), is_macd_golden_state = VALUES(is_macd_golden_state), is_macd_red = VALUES(is_macd_red), macd_hist_direction = VALUES(macd_hist_direction), sar_value = VALUES(sar_value), is_sar_bullish = VALUES(is_sar_bullish), sar_trend = VALUES(sar_trend), ma5 = d_value = VALUES(d_value), j_value = VALUES(j_value), boll_mid = VALUES(boll_mid), boll_upper = VALUES(boll_upper), boll_lower = VALUES(boll_lower), atr14 = VALUES(atr14), adx14 = VALUES(adx14),
